Ski Hut Wednesday Night Social Ride

Duluth, MN · Road · Social

Ski Hut Wednesday Night Social Ride is a road and social group ride in Duluth, MN. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Location announced weekly by email and social media.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner-friendly. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @theskihut the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ski Hut Wednesday Night Social Ride group ride

A beginner-friendly evening ride of about 20 miles put on by the Ski Hut. The start moves around Duluth; the shop posts each week's location. Runs through the summer.
